strata.label: defeated opponent
strata.definition: Competitor X defeated opponent Y in at least one completed competitive contest.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: beat/defeat/trounce/rout/upset/victory over; completed sporting sweep/outlast/elimination; explicit electoral defeat of an opposing competitor; historical win despite losses in other games. Excludes: mere play/face/rivalry; standings or polling lead; losing to Y; winning an event rather than beating Y; political control or hostility alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare outscore/surpass/shock without a completed-contest result; score margin for only one period; unclear geographic/team metonymy. Preserves the two full-census opponent-win scope, including electoral contests. Broader competed-against belongs only in a separately declared sensitivity where the prior primary was defeat.

strata.label: analyst at organization
strata.definition: Person X works or worked as an analyst for organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit analyst at/for/with/of; following or tracking an industry or companies for an employer when it identifies professional analysis. Excludes: director/president/professor/scientist/spokesperson/editor/lawyer/partner alone; generic affiliation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: economist-only, forecaster, strategist or specialist at the analyst role boundary; unclear role/employer attachment. Preserves the earlier full-census A boundary for nearby financial roles; do not silently label all financial employment analyst.

strata.label: coach of

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit coach title; direct coaching with correct subject and team; former/dismissed coach with clear office evidence; team/university shorthand when the athletic program role is clear. Excludes: manager/president/player alone; winning with a team alone; vacancy consideration alone; reverse team-to-coach direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: missing coach subject or team attachment.

strata.label: president or manager of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team, public body or institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit president or manager title or unambiguous manage-as-office evidence; general manager; borough president and community-board manager; functional presidency within an organization; historical tenure. Excludes: chair/director/executive/head alone; owner/founder/coach/player alone; generic running or control without the specified role; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal replacing omitted organization/campaign; missing title modifier that could change the office. This deliberately composite legacy operational predicate is retained for comparability. Mark manager-only support broad_predicate. It is not a claim that president and manager are interchangeable atomic relations. A narrower president-only sensitivity requires separate complete re-evaluation, not selective changes.

strata.label: winner or champion of

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of

strata.label: geographical part of

strata.label: has or had wife

Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear whose wife Y is; wife versus other companion attachment unresolved; engagement without established marriage. strata.label: directed communication to
strata.definition: Person or institution X directs information, speech, request, advice, warning or a message to addressee Y.

strata.label: political body has a leader
strata.definition: Country, political body or legislature X has or had person Y as a political leader.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: national president/ruler/head of government; named parliamentary majority/minority leader or whip; historical leadership. Excludes: corporate/team leadership; ordinary membership/meeting; party control instead of an individual leader; person-to-body forward direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unspecified minister without evidence of head-of-government or leadership scope; truncated body or unnamed officeholder. Harmonizes the later minister-inclusive samples to the original full-census scope. An unspecified minister alone is A, not automatically S.

strata.label: lives or has lived in

strata.scope_notes: Includes: live/resident/residence/home-in; explicit resettlement or being raised there; death at own home in a place when home attachment is clear. strata.label: managerial or leadership office in

strata.label: met or encountered
strata.definition: Person, group, institution, or sports team X actually met or encountered Y.

Excludes: communication alone without an encounter; a proposed or scheduled meeting not established as occurring; physical confluence of rivers or geographic features; mere co-occurrence or comparison. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: future or planned meeting when occurrence is unresolved; meeting versus satisfying an abstract requirement; unclear representatives or participants. The primary direction follows the extracted arguments, although an encounter is semantically mutual. Team meetings include competitive encounters but do not imply a result.

strata.label: manager of institution
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified manager office in organization, team, business, or public institution Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit manager or general manager; a functional or departmental managerial office within Y; historical managerial office. Excludes: president, director, head, executive, or coach alone without a manager title; ordinary employment or membership; candidate or proposed appointment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: a personal principal standing for an omitted institution or campaign; unclear manager or institutional attachment; appointment without established tenure. strata.label: editor of publication
strata.definition: Person X serves or served as an editor of, for, or at publication Y.

strata.label: known or named as

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit known-as or also-called identity; a stated alias or alternative name; historical renaming of the same entity. Excludes: a named subsidiary or distinct entity; comparison or resemblance rather than identity; ordinary description without an alternative designation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear referent of the alternative name; an explicitly proposed new name without established use; name versus separate institution when unresolved. strata.label: practices law in place
strata.definition: Person X is explicitly described as a lawyer practicing or professionally based in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer-in place; a city or geographic nominal modifier of a lawyer establishing professional location; historical legal practice in the place. Excludes: representing a client or institution alone; a law firm or personal client in the geographic argument slot; residence or travel alone without legal practice. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: public attorney office for a jurisdiction without evidence of practice location; geographic versus institutional meaning of Y unresolved; unclear attachment of the place to the lawyer. Separate from lawyer_for, which concerns representation or professional institutional affiliation. A governmental jurisdiction as client or office does not automatically establish this geographic practice predicate.

strata.label: athlete plays for team
strata.definition: Person X plays or played as an athlete for sports team Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: player/center/guard/wing/captain/scorer role on a team; playing for or with the team as athlete; scoring for the team. Excludes: coach/manager/owner alone; team leading or beating another team; generic lead without athlete context; reverse team-to-athlete direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare lead without player/position/scoring context.

strata.label: leader or organizational head of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held a leader, head, president, chief or chair office in group, institution, organization or political body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit leader/head/president/chief/chair; legislative majority/minority leadership or whip; leadership office within an identified body; historical office. Excludes: ordinary membership or service; founding/ownership alone; party control of a chamber; candidate alone; athletic/standings or task-only lead; editor alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic director or executive without clear leadership role; bare lead lacking organizational-role context; materially truncated political body. Preserves the narrower leader/head family used in the two original full censuses; managerial_office_in separately accepts explicit director/executive titles.

strata.label: has minister

strata.label: contributed writing to publication
strata.definition: Person X wrote, reviewed or contributed as a critic for publication Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: wrote/reviewed for or in a publication; explicit critic for publication with authorship role. Excludes: merely quoted or mentioned in publication; publication location; ordinary communication or employment without authorship. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: say-in without author/quoted-speaker distinction.

strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
strata.definition: Organization or business unit X is or was a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational unit of parent Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit subsidiary/unit/division/organizational-part; corporate owned-by or an explicit parent relationship in the child-to-parent direction; historical containment or ownership. Excludes: employment; geographic containment; ordinary affiliation; reverse parent-to-child direction; a proposed acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city standing for an unnamed office; minority investment alone without evidence of organizational containment; incomplete ownership attachment. Explicit ownership is evidence; a minority financial stake alone does not establish that the company is a subsidiary. Do not confuse a part-of-company with a geographic part.

strata.label: politically controlled by
strata.definition: Political institution, legislature, government, or geographic territory X is or was politically controlled by group or government Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit political control, takeover, or governing majority by Y; historical control including clearly established loss of prior control. Excludes: an ordinary member or individual officeholder without group control; corporate ownership; political support or influence alone; proposed takeover without realization. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic have, take, or govern without clear control context; unclear political body or group identity; control versus ordinary office unresolved. Inverse of politically_controls. A mere member of a legislature does not establish party control.

strata.label: died in place
strata.definition: Person X, or an explicitly identified subset of population X, died in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit died-in or death-in location; being killed in Y establishing death there; historical death location. Excludes: residence, birth, or ordinary presence alone; Y is the perpetrator or cause rather than location; discussion of deaths without the affected person or population. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution unresolved; unclear death or geographic attachment; a population mention without identified affected members. This describes location of death, not where X lived or who caused death. An affected subset does not imply every member died.

strata.label: lawyer or attorney for
strata.definition: Person X serves or served as attorney, lawyer or legal counsel for client, employer, organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer/attorney/counsel for/at/with client or employer; legal employment at a firm; explicit governmental attorney office for a jurisdiction. Excludes: private lawyer merely located in a city; spokesperson/director/lobbyist alone; reverse client-to-lawyer direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city as location versus represented jurisdiction; firm partner without a clear legal-role attachment.

strata.label: leader or organizational head of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held a leader, head, president, chief or chair office in group, institution, organization or political body Y.

Excludes: ordinary membership or service; founding/ownership alone; party control of a chamber; candidate alone; athletic/standings or task-only lead; editor alone. strata.label: has member
strata.definition: Organization, organized group, team, or institutional body X has or had entity Y as a member.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit membership or being included as a group member; a clearly established office or athlete role that entails membership of the stated group; historical membership. Excludes: corporate subsidiary ownership without membership in an explicitly identified group; a geographic area containing a place; ordinary accompaniment or a meeting; planned membership without established admission. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic include or join without group-membership context; unclear group versus geographic or corporate containment; proposed admission or unresolved member identity. Inverse of member_of. A leader belongs to the stated group when local evidence establishes that institutional role; mere political support or family relation is insufficient.

strata.label: wins or holds sporting championship
strata.definition: Entity X won sporting competition Y or held an explicitly Y-designated sporting championship or title.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: sport win/champion/title/clinch-title; sporting league/division or explicitly title-designating body; historical sporting title. Excludes: non-sport honorary awards; political election or control; participation; single stage without overall title; coaching or team membership alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: medal without a winning championship; unclear title attachment. Retains the original sports-only relation separately from winner_of; do not silently extend it to Nobel or political examples.

strata.label: chairperson of

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit chair/chairman/chairwoman/chairperson; co-chair if explicit; past tenure or resignation from that office. Excludes: president/head/executive/director alone; founder/owner/member alone; nomination/candidacy alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: ambiguous successor or appointment that does not establish tenure; chair of an omitted subunit. Do not widen a prior specific-chair declaration to managerial office because its facts would then score better.

strata.label: moves or travels to
strata.definition: Person, group or organization X undertakes movement with geographic destination Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: move/relocate/return/arrive/go/visit to Y; depart/leave for Y; temporary travel or organizational relocation; bare unqualified destination movement as textual support. Excludes: leave/withdraw from Y; mere presence/residence/death place; sports-event qualification or attendance as a nongeographic destination; membership or political control. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: explicitly hypothetical or proposed relocation; invasion-only boundary; geographic/team or theatrical metonymy. Permanent residence and completed arrival are not required. Do not import external history to reject an otherwise unqualified textual movement path.

strata.scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.

strata.label: executive of
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

strata.label: member of organization
strata.definition: Person, country or organization X is or becomes a member of organization, alliance, party or public body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit member/belong/membership; join/accession/entry when organizational membership is established; individual legislators and countries in alliances. Excludes: join a person in an action; geographic entry; event participation; party control of legislature; negotiations or proposed membership alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare join without clear completion or membership meaning; plural party naming individual members rather than the party itself.

strata.label: departed from
strata.definition: Person, group or organization X physically leaves or withdraws from geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: leave/withdraw/pull out from Y; historical physical departure. Excludes: arrival/return to Y; residence alone; leaving a job or team as an institution without geography. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution as source; explicitly conditional departure.

strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit war-with or fought-against in an armed-conflict context; actual military attack or combat against Y; historical military adversaries. Excludes: sports competition or metaphorical political attack; cooperation, alliance, or joint action on the same side; border adjacency or diplomatic relations alone; planned conflict without realization. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: fight-with whose allied versus adversarial sense is unresolved; generic attack without military context; future threat or proposed war. Military adversarial conflict is distinct from cooperation and from criticizing. The predicate does not imply a winner.

Excludes: X appointed a third person to replace Y; generic opposition, criticism, or substitution unrelated to a role; a proposed successor without established tenure. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare replace where appointing versus taking over is unresolved; unclear predecessor or role; candidate or announced future replacement without tenure. Direction is successor to predecessor. It does not imply that X and Y are the same person or held office simultaneously.

strata.label: official of institution
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified official role in institution or governmental body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Includes: explicit official-of, official-at, or institutional official description; historical official role; a named formal public office that unambiguously entails official status. Excludes: ordinary employment without an official role; a city dateline or institution standing in the person slot; a generic adviser or spokesperson without official status; proposed appointment alone.
